title: Putting Google's Network to work for You
summary: A seven-minute Google I/O 2014 talk by Simon Newton on how developers can make use of Google's global network. It describes the network's footprint and some of the services running on it.
why: HN commenters, including a Googler, cite it as the public explanation of how Google serves traffic, including DNS-based load balancing.

quote.text: the video by Simon Newton which describes the global footprint and some of the services
